services.name: Willamette Falls Private Tour
services.desc: Come sightseeing on the incredible Willamette River with us! 2 Hours Description On tours cruising to the Willamette Falls, you will see Portland and Lake Oswego’s most beautiful homes, plenty of wildlife such as osprey, bald eagles, river otters, beavers, sea lions, and the majestic Willamette Falls in Oregon City! Regardless of the direction of travel, and no matter where we go, the Willamette River is full of natural beauty and wildlife! Cruising in either direction you will see some of Oregon’s beautiful nature in the city, historical landmarks, famous movie locations, and even Just Your Crew • Up to 6 People • 2 Hours

services.name: Portland Historic Bridges Private Tour
services.desc: Come sightseeing on the incredible Willamette River with us! 2 Hours Description On tours cruising to the downtown, you will see Portland's 9 unique and historical drawbridges, plenty of nature, the city skyline, and the Port of Portland. At the port we will get up close to ocean going ships, the huge drydocks and see the Portland shipping yards from the water. Regardless of the direction of travel, and no matter where we go, the Willamette River is full of natural beauty and wildlife! services.name: Sunset and City Lights Private Tour
services.desc: Two-hour sunset sightseeing cruise on the Willamette River featuring city bridges, floating homes, wildlife and evening city lights. Just Your Crew • Up to 6 People • 2 Hours

services.name: Island Wildlife & Nature Private Tour
services.desc: Come sightseeing on the incredible Willamette River with us! 2 Hours Description This is our popular nature lovers “coffee cruise” We cruise towards downtown and around the Ross Island natural area. On this tour we seek out all forms of the river’s natural beauty and wildlife! On any given cruise we should see bald eagles, osprey, blue heron, deer, turtles, otters, and beavers! During the fishing season we may even see sea lions chasing salmon! Regardless of the direction of travel, and no matter where we go, the Willamette River is full of natural beauty and wildlife! Cruising in Just Your Crew • Up to 6 People • 2 Hours
